name: Gloom Stalker

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A hunter of the dark who strikes first from the shadows and is unseen by those who rely on darkvision.

feature.name: Dread Ambusher
feature.summary: Add Wisdom to Initiative; +10 feet of Speed on your first turn; Dreadful Strike adds 2d6 Psychic once per turn (Wisdom-modifier uses per Long Rest).
feature.text: Ambusher's Leap: at the start of your first turn of each combat, your Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn. Dreadful Strike: when you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 2d6 Psychic damage, once per turn, a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once); you regain the uses on a Long Rest. Initiative Bonus: when you roll Initiative, you add your Wisdom modifier to the roll. The Initiative bonus is applied; the rest waits for the combat engine.

feature.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
feature.summary: Disguise Self always prepared; more at levels 5, 9, 13 and 17.
feature.text: When you reach a Ranger level shown, you always have these spells prepared; they don't count against your Prepared Spells: Disguise Self (3); Rope Trick (5); Fear (9); Greater Invisibility (13); Seeming (17).

feature.name: Umbral Sight
feature.summary: Darkvision 60 feet (or 60 feet more), and creatures relying on Darkvision can't see you while you're in Darkness.
feature.text: You gain Darkvision with a range of 60 feet; if you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet. You are also adept at evading creatures that rely on Darkvision: while entirely in Darkness, you have the Invisible condition against any creature that relies on Darkvision to see you there.

feature.name: Iron Mind
feature.summary: Proficiency in Wisdom saving throws, or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it.
feature.text: You have honed your ability to resist mind-altering powers. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws; if you already have it, you gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws instead (your choice).

options.name: Wisdom saving throws
options.summary: Take this unless you already have it.

options.name: Intelligence saving throws
options.summary: Only if you already have Wisdom saving throws.

options.name: Charisma saving throws
options.summary: Only if you already have Wisdom saving throws.

feature.name: Stalker's Flurry
feature.summary: Dreadful Strike's damage becomes 2d8, and each use can add a Sudden Strike or a Mass Fear.

feature.name: Shadowy Dodge
feature.summary: Reaction: impose Disadvantage on an attack against you, then teleport 30 feet if it misses.
